purpose: Teacher-authorized student-specific Portfolio report delivery using the private Drive archive; no grading or evidence decisions occur here.

source.staff_directory: not required when support_contacts contains staff_email; never infer missing addresses

prepare_email_reports.rule: Read Latest Portfolio Results.zip, validate results_manifest.json, convert each active individual self-contained HTML report to PDF, write/replace current PDFs in 03 Student Packets/Email Delivery, and rebuild email_delivery_manifest.csv. Do not regrade, reread evidence, or modify Portfolio grades.

preflight.custom_note_field: empty optional field per student; saved privately only when entered
preflight.weekly_note: optional class-wide note; never hardcode dates/events
preflight.support_staff_default: include active support staff with valid email addresses when available; display exact staff name, role, support class when present, and email in preflight
preflight.blocked_rows: may be excluded by teacher checkbox; excluded rows do not block the rest of the send
preflight.left_checkbox: Send checkbox appears left of student name; uncheck to omit this send only.
preflight.class_action: Remove from class explicitly marks student_registry.csv active=no while preserving evidence/history.
preflight.custom_note_polish: Teacher-entered note fragments are cleaned deterministically and use the student first name instead of guessing gendered pronouns. Teacher reviews polished text before sending.

recipients.privacy: Use BCC for non-student recipients. Deduplicate all addresses. Never share a Drive report folder as a substitute for student-specific delivery.
recipients.support_roles: course-agnostic free text; do not restrict routing to a fixed role allowlist

family_language.not_assessed: We have not checked this Mastery Goal yet.
family_language.needs_first_check: We have not checked this skill yet.
family_language.powerschool: PowerSchool shows one current grade for each Mastery Goal once that goal has been assessed. Individual evidence sources are not separate grades averaged together.
family_language.weekly_note_rule: Only include teacher-entered weekly note text.
family_language.in_progress: An I means In Progress. It is not permanent. It reflects current evidence and can change as new or stronger evidence is added; earlier checks are not averaged in as permanent penalties.

support_contact_schema.role_rule: Free text, course-agnostic. Common examples: Case Manager, Special Education Teacher, Study Skills Teacher, Academic Support Teacher, Resource Room Teacher.
support_contact_schema.support_class_rule: Optional free text for any support/resource/study-skills class; blank for relationships not tied to a class.
support_contact_schema.active_rule: Only truthy active rows with a valid staff_email are eligible recipients.
support_contact_schema.privacy_rule: Do not store disability, diagnosis, accommodation narrative, or other IEP details in this routing file.

identity_safety.hard_rule: Never send an attachment unless the prepared manifest explicitly records identity_verified=true for that student and the manifest student_name exactly matches the current recipient roster row.
identity_safety.html_prepare: Before HTML-to-PDF conversion, verify the individual HTML visibly contains the exact manifest student name.
identity_safety.pdf_prepare: A PDF path is accepted only when the results manifest explicitly marks identity_verified=true from a prior exact identity check.
identity_safety.stale_manifest: Legacy manifests without identity_verified are blocked and require Prepare / Refresh Email Reports.
